verifier_commands.name: verify-fixpoint
verifier_commands._note: F-019: bare `llmll verify` runs liquid-fixpoint and writes the .verified.json sidecar. The subsequent --trust-report invocation reads that sidecar to surface verified-tier evidence. Without this step, the trust report floors at `asserted` even for QF-LIA-verifiable programs.

verifier_commands.name: verify
verifier_commands._note: Top-level --json flag is required to get structured trust-report output; --trust-report alone produces human-readable text. Reads the .verified.json sidecar written by the verify-fixpoint step above.

all-expected-contracts-verified-or-asser.description: Verify exits with all expected contracts at tier 'verified' or 'asserted' in the trust report; check --strict and test return exit code 0.
